_comment: Card format counts for tests/format-counts.test.ts (CR audit Phase 2, guard 4). history: dated entries; the last one must equal the code. A count may only shrink; an entry that raises one needs a reason saying why the format had to grow. knownPrimitiveKinds = KNOWN_PRIMITIVE_KINDS size; oneCardKinds = kinds exactly one card's JSON uses; cardDefFlags = optional boolean and number CardDef fields (tests/baselines/card-flags.json counts.cardDefFlags).

history.reason: CR audit area 1: host_self_as_condition replaces three engine-built host-as-condition continuations.

PF-S3a: Retrieval Run's optional breach replacement needs its own may_ kind (the old runEvent field always skipped the breach, CR 1.2.1), and a once-per-run ability used only when its optional part is carried out needs mark_ability_used_this_run (Snitch, CR 9.6.9d); no existing kind does either.

PF-S3b: Executive Wiretaps reveals HQ without gaining credits, so it needs a plain reveal_hq (Expert Schedule Analyzer builds it too); The Future Perfect's 'cannot steal this agenda during this access' needs forbid_steal_accessed_agenda (Pinhole Threading's lock lasts the run and also forbids the trash). runner_lose_credits_equal_corp_bad_publicity is gone (Ireress gains one subroutine per bad publicity through the per_bad_publicity declaration). One-card kinds also move because cards changed kind: may_install_from_heap and reveal_hq_gain_credits are left with one card each (Clone Chip and Executive Wiretaps moved off them), while Susanoo-no-Mikoto and Strongbox give forbid_jack_out_until_next_encounter and spend_click_additional_cost a second card. The five renamed may_ and verb-first kinds keep their counts.
